settings.heading: The booth lives on Instagram
settings.lede: New pulls, uranium glow-checks, shirt drops, and “we’re here tonight” posts land first at @lolaandlime.

settings.heading: About the vibe
settings.lede: Lola & Lime is a handmade, high-contrast treasure hunt — retro-kitsch, a little tiki, a lot of cut-and-paste. Think 60s–70s scrapbook pages taped over a flea-market tablecloth, not a minimal web shop.
settings.quote: “If it glows, clinks, or looks like it survived a backyard luau — it belongs here.”
